results.title: I Want To Be A Butterfly
results.overview: On the day of his school recital, nine-year-old Khimo struggles to tell a story about a child who dreams of becoming a butterfly, as fragments of his childhood reveal a disturbing truth hidden beneath his innocent imagination.

results.title: Etude of Silence
results.overview: Etude of Silence (Iran, 2026, 17 min) follows a young actress who is repeatedly cast as dead bodies in film productions until the boundary between performance and reality begins to disappear. The film follows a young aspiring actress who survives on the margins of the film industry, repeatedly cast as corpses, victims, and silent bodies in low-budget productions. As she spends her days performing death for the camera, the boundary between performance and reality begins to dissolve, leading her into an unsettling confrontation with invisibility and self-erasure.

results.title: Honey's Christmas Wish

results.title: Baby Talk
results.overview: As her wedding to the father of her unborn child looms, Leo steals a precious day with best friend Amy to find a wedding dress on the final leg of a road trip home.

results.title: The Tara on Her Head
results.overview: An elderly man has always perceived reality as tilted. Gradually, however, everything seems to turn upside down—even the image of Green Tara, to whom he makes daily offerings.  His youngest son, a monk at a temple, is summoned home; he finds himself navigating the boundary between reality and illusion as he tries to understand what is happening to his father.  The most conceptual film in the competition reinterprets themes and figures from Tibetan Buddhism, transporting them into a realm suspended between spirituality, paradox, and irony.

results.title: Agbara Nla: The Return
results.overview: When a feared village doctor rises with dark spiritual power to terrorize the land, a young courageous couple, Olatomi and Olaboye, must embrace their divine calling to confront evil, ignite revival, and prove that no power is greater than the name of Jesus.

results.title: Frankie’s Way - When Baking Pizza Becomes a Crime
results.original_title: Frankie’s Way - When Baking Pizza Becomes a Crime
results.overview: Frankie lives in Prague and starts making Neapolitan pizza at home, out of a tiny electric oven, for the delight of his friends. After some months, what was a passion-fueled pastime ends up turning into an actual business. Thanks to word of mouth and social networks, tens of clients buy his pizza every week and his apartment turns into a social hub for pizza lovers. Is this the first step to a collective addiction? Success never comes easy, they say... and in fact, as soon as the word is out about these delicious pizzas, Pulcinella, guardian mask of Neapolitan traditions, senses the mockery and drags Frankie in front of the Supreme Court of the Commedia dell’Arte masks. Pulcinella believes Frankie has no right to customize such an ancient tradition to his liking.
